text:
maya: Opening a small PR to modernize the Quickstart hello-world walkthrough. Scope: clarify auth, add a tiny Vercel serverless ephemeral-key example, include a minimal curl example, update SDK snippets to v8-style client usage, and fix the broken 'deploy' link. Need at least one docs + one eng review.
ryan: Prefer separate commits for (A) auth/docs changes, (B) SDK snippet updates, (C) link + minor UX nits. makes rollbacks easier.
nora: Please add a curl example for troubleshooting connectivity. most newcomers try curl first and DM us when it fails.
maya: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899 (WIP). Curl example I'll add under "Test locally":
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
```
selma: Also include a short Docker tip: remind folks to EXPOSE 3000 in the sample Dockerfile and pass the key when running: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 3000:3000 my-hello`
ryan: For the SDK snippets, I'll convert the old fetch examples to the new Client pattern. Add a one-liner about pinning model versions in examples to avoid silent regressions.
maya: Good call on pinning. I'll add `model: "redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01"` in examples and a note about updating.
nora: Tiny nit: we standardized env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY in all samples, don't introduce variations.
maya: Affirmed 44d keeping REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.
selma: For the Vercel ephemeral-key example, add a short caution about function cold starts and suggest caching the ephemeral key for the duration of the invocation only.
maya: I'll add a 3-line Vercel serverless example and a GitHub Actions snippet for CI smoke test (using secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY). Example serverless function sample:
```
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY; // ephemeral or project key
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello from serverless' })
  });
  const out = await r.json();
  res.status(200).json(out);
}
```
ryan: Can you include steps for a local smoke test? i.e. `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl. Also mention clearing local KV cache if people see stale outputs during dev.
nora: Also add a one-line troubleshooting section: check env var exported, check that API key isn't expired, and ensure port mapping when running in Docker.
maya: Done. Also fixed the broken deploy link to point to /docs/deploy/quickstart.
docbot: deploy-bot: preview build queued for PR 4899 03 (ETA ~8m)
selma: Quick look at wording: s/ephemeral key/ephemeral token/ in the Vercel note? token is the term we've been using elsewhere.
maya: Switched to 'ephemeral token' per guidance.
ryan: I'll review the SDK commit later today. If green, we can merge and create a follow-up issue to migrate remaining examples.
maya: Marking follow-up issue: docs#219 - migrate remaining examples to client v8 over next sprint. Assigning ryan.
nora: LGTM from a newbie UX perspective. Short and scannable.

ryan: Thanks, will pick up issue docs#219. Closing thread.
